drivers: Houthi strikes on Saudi refineries (Ras Tanura, Rabigh)
US Gulf output shut in ahead of storm; Deer Park outage
Coker restarts and easing feedstock costs offset
outlooks.summary: Refinery and Gulf disruptions are bullish, but they mostly hit crude and fuels, not coke directly. Coker restarts, easing anode feedstock costs and a 16% price drop over 3 months point to a balanced picture.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch whether Gulf Coast refinery and coker output recovers after the storm and whether Saudi strikes continue.
outlooks.summary_zh: 炼厂和墨西哥湾的供应中断属利多,但主要影响原油和燃料,并非直接影响石油焦。焦化装置重启、阳极原料成本回落,加上价格三个月下跌16%,整体偏平衡。
drivers_zh: 胡塞武装袭击沙特炼厂(拉斯塔努拉、拉比格)
风暴来袭前美国墨西哥湾产量停产;迪尔帕克炼厂停运
焦化装置重启及阳极原料成本回落形成对冲
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注风暴过后美国墨西哥湾沿岸炼厂和焦化装置能否恢复,以及沙特遇袭是否持续。

drivers: Fed rate-hike fears and strong dollar
Gold at 14-month low
Central bank and ETF buying retreating
outlooks.summary: Headlines are about macro pressure, not supply. Strong dollar, higher yields and weaker buying point to downside, not a shortage-driven rise.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch the next Fed meeting and US yield and dollar moves.
outlooks.summary_zh: 相关新闻集中在宏观压力而非供应。美元走强、收益率上升和买盘减弱指向下行风险,而非供应短缺推动的上涨。
drivers_zh: 美联储加息担忧与美元走强
金价跌至14个月低点
央行和ETF购金减弱
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注下一次美联储会议以及美国收益率和美元走势。

drivers: Congo export quotas halve Glencore output
India black mass export ban
Chinese miner suspends DR Congo operations
outlooks.summary: Congo quotas and a mine suspension keep supply tight. Price is down 24% over 3 months but up 26% over the year, so some tightness is priced in, yet more upside is possible.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Congo quota adjustments and any restart of the suspended DR Congo operations.
outlooks.summary_zh: 刚果配额和矿山停产使供应偏紧。价格三个月下跌24%、年内上涨26%,部分紧缺已被计入,但仍有上行空间。
drivers_zh: 刚果出口配额使嘉能可产量减半
印度禁止黑粉出口
中国矿企暂停刚果(金)业务
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注刚果配额调整以及被暂停的刚果(金)业务能否复产。

drivers: Chile copper output near 23-year low
China smelter squeeze and cuts
China export control rules
outlooks.summary: Moly is mostly a copper by-product, so weak Chilean copper output and smelter cuts tighten supply. Price is already up 18% in 3 months, so part of this is priced in.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Chilean copper output data and Chinese smelter cuts.
outlooks.summary_zh: 钼主要是铜的副产品,智利铜产量低迷和冶炼厂减产会收紧供应。价格三个月已涨18%,部分利多已被计入。
drivers_zh: 智利铜产量接近23年低位
中国冶炼厂承压减产
中国出口管制新规
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注智利铜产量数据及中国冶炼厂减产情况。

drivers: Zimbabwe lithium export tax and local sourcing rules
Possible Zimbabwe export ban on lithium sulphate
India black mass export ban
outlooks.summary: Zimbabwe policy and India's export ban add some supply risk. Price fell 13% in 3 months and the headlines are indirect, so conviction is low.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch whether Zimbabwe delays or enforces its lithium sulphate export ban.
outlooks.summary_zh: 津巴布韦政策和印度出口禁令增加了一定供应风险。但价格三个月下跌13%,且新闻多为间接影响,把握度较低。
drivers_zh: 津巴布韦锂出口税及本地采购规定
津巴布韦可能禁止硫酸锂出口
印度禁止黑粉出口
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注津巴布韦是推迟还是执行硫酸锂出口禁令。

drivers: Laos suspends rare earth operations after dam breach
Yttrium supplies stalled amid China curbs on Japan
Export controls suspension only extended to Jan 2027
outlooks.summary: Yttrium shortages, curbs on Japan and a Laos suspension tighten supply. Price is up 36% over the year, but shortages look ongoing, so further upside is likely.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch for restart of Laos operations and any change to China's export control suspension before January 2027.
outlooks.summary_zh: 钇短缺、中国对日本的限制以及老挝停产使供应趋紧。价格年内上涨36%,但短缺仍在持续,可能进一步上行。
drivers_zh: 老挝溃坝后暂停稀土作业
在中国对日限制下钇供应停滞
出口管制暂停仅延至2027年1月
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注老挝作业能否复产,以及2027年1月前中国出口管制暂停安排是否变化。

drivers: Congo conflict and Indonesia cuts
Myanmar mining pollution issues
Chile copper and smelter stress
outlooks.summary: Congo conflict and Indonesian cuts keep supply tight, with Myanmar pollution a further risk. Price is up 56% over the year but flat over 3 months, so much is priced in, though risks remain.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Indonesian export and output data and Myanmar mine access.
outlooks.summary_zh: 刚果冲突和印尼减产使供应偏紧,缅甸污染问题带来额外风险。价格年内上涨56%但三个月持平,大部分已被计入,风险仍存。
drivers_zh: 刚果冲突和印尼减产
缅甸矿区污染问题
智利铜产量和冶炼厂承压
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注印尼出口和产量数据以及缅甸矿区的准入情况。

drivers: Major Chinese antimony mine halts production
China's US export ban suspension nears expiry
Export deadline approaching
outlooks.summary: A mine halt in China and the expiring export suspension raise supply risk. Price is down 56% over the year, so there is room to rise from a low base.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch whether China's suspension of the US export ban is renewed or lapses.
outlooks.summary_zh: 中国一座大型锑矿停产,出口禁令暂停即将到期,增加供应风险。价格年内下跌56%,基数较低,有反弹空间。
drivers_zh: 中国一座大型锑矿停产
中国对美出口禁令暂停即将到期
出口截止日临近
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注中国对美出口禁令的暂停是否延期或到期失效。

drivers: Export controls biting on ex-China supply
Germanium supply chain risk flagged
Price up 67% in 3 months
outlooks.summary: Chinese export controls keep supply tight and new ex-China projects will take time. The price has already jumped 67% in 3 months, so some is priced in, but supply risk remains.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch China's export control decisions and funding for non-China projects.
outlooks.summary_zh: 中国出口管制使供应保持紧张,中国以外的新项目需要时间。价格三个月已大涨67%,部分已被计入,但供应风险仍在。
drivers_zh: 出口管制冲击非中国供应
锗供应链风险受到关注
价格三个月上涨67%
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注中国出口管制决定以及中国以外项目的融资进展。

drivers: Houthi strikes on Saudi refineries
US Gulf output shut ahead of storm
Easing anode feedstock costs and coker restarts
outlooks.summary: Disruptions are bullish but mostly indirect, and coker restarts and softer feedstock costs offset them. Price is up 15% already, so the picture is balanced.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Gulf Coast refinery recovery and anode producer demand for coke.
outlooks.summary_zh: 供应中断属利多但多为间接影响,焦化装置重启和原料成本走软形成对冲。价格已上涨15%,整体偏平衡。
drivers_zh: 胡塞武装袭击沙特炼厂
风暴来袭前美国墨西哥湾停产
阳极原料成本回落及焦化装置重启
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注墨西哥湾沿岸炼厂恢复情况及阳极厂商的焦炭需求。

drivers: Saudi refinery strikes and Gulf storm shut-ins
Coker restarts and lower fuel costs
Price down 5% over 3 months
outlooks.summary: Refinery disruptions are bullish but largely indirect, while restarts and weaker demand offset them. Price fell 5% over 3 months after a large annual rise.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Gulf Coast refinery restarts and Middle East attacks on refineries.
outlooks.summary_zh: 炼厂中断属利多但多为间接影响,重启和需求走弱形成对冲。在年内大涨后,价格三个月下跌5%。
drivers_zh: 沙特炼厂遇袭及风暴致墨西哥湾停产
焦化装置重启及燃料成本下降
价格三个月下跌5%
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注墨西哥湾沿岸炼厂重启及中东对炼厂的袭击。
